neighbours.label: A car model name right after the manufacturer (Honda Civic, Ford Focus, Chevy Suburban), vs the make alone or the same word in its ordinary sense
fire: My neighbour just bought a 2012 Toyota Corolla with low mileage.
We rented a Nissan Leaf for the weekend trip.
Dad still drives his old Ford Fiesta to work.
The 1998 Honda Accord in the lot needs new brakes.
She traded her Volkswagen Polo for a Subaru Outback.
For towing, a Chevy Silverado is hard to beat.
The rally winner drove a Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution.
Our first family car was a Renault Clio.
quiet: My neighbour just bought a 2012 Toyota with low mileage.
A single leaf fell onto the windshield during the trip.
Dad still drives his old Ford to work.
The peace accord was signed after long talks.
The outback town has only one petrol station.

predictions: The model name after a make reaches 0.5-1.0; the make alone and ordinary-sense words stay under 0.2.
